stemMarkdown: 7 workers, each working 7 hours a day, can complete a job in 18 days. How many days will 10 workers, each working 8 hours a day, take to complete the same job? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Total work $= 7 \times 18 \times 7$ worker-hours $= 882$. With 10 workers at 8 hours/day, days needed $= \dfrac{882}{10\times8} = 11.03$.
